header.title: Shariah-compliant
header.description: Learn how Klaim provides transparent Murabaha financing to help healthcare providers improve cash flow while remaining aligned with Shariah principles and Saudi regulatory requirements.

sections.title: Principles
sections.description: All financing is structured using a Shariah-compliant Murabaha arrangement. Pricing is transparent, agreed upon upfront, and fully disclosed before execution.

sections.title: Transaction Structure
sections.description: Every financing transaction is supported by clear contractual documentation, a predefined payment schedule, and complete disclosure of pricing and terms.

sections.title: Compliance
sections.description: Murabaha financing is structured in accordance with Shariah principles and in compliance with the applicable laws and regulations of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

contactBanner.title: Questions about Shariah compliance?
contactBanner.description: If you have any questions about our Shariah-compliant financing, please don't hesitate to contact us.
